notes.title: Judy DLC compatibility
notes.notes:
Update Available

This update is primarily focused on ensuring compatibility with the Judy DLC. Additionally, we have taken the opportunity to implement minor visual improvements and performance optimizations. We have also fixed several small bugs to provide you with a smoother experience.

Thank you for continuing to enjoy the game!

notes.title: Judy DLC
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We’d like to take this opportunity to sincerely thank all of you who have played Forest 6174.
Even though we’re a very small team, we feel like giants every time we read your reviews, feedback, and comments.

Thank you so much for your support — it truly means the world to us.

We’re happy to announce that we’re currently working on a free DLC, which will expand the game a bit further, especially the storyline surrounding Judy.

We’ll be sharing updates and more details very soon.

Once again, thank you so much.

— The itandfeel team

notes.title: The day is almost here!
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce that Forest 6174 is ready for its official launch on April 30th!

Wishlist it now to be notified.

Thank you for your support! 😉

notes.title: Echoes of Forest6174 in six languages...
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce that translations are underway!

The game will be available in: English, German, Japanese, Korean, Russian, and Spanish.

We're almost there...

Don’t forget to wishlist and follow for updates. Thank you! 😉
